page.notes: Greek scholia are printed in italic type; several Greek words are doubtful at this scan resolution and are marked [?]. The Greek line "παρθένιοι παῖδες ... νομιζομένων παρθένων" is only partly legible. Printed spellings kept as they stand: "Pythia", "Trophonij", "Æpyto", "urbem". Long s printed as f in "refponfa" is read as "responsa". The last line "ceus" completes the word "Phoeni-ceus" and is the end of the text, not a catchword.
